'''Cliff hawks''' were [[Bird/Legends|avian]] predators native to [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. Their plumage was speckled with browns and grays, allowing them to naturally blend into the mountainous regions in which they hunted. Common prey included small [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]], [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]], and their fellow brethren. Huge, grotesque talons enabled the cliff hawk to hang upside down, an arcane ability for a bird of such size. Cliff hawks seldom flew, instead preferring to scurry about on two legs.
